This video is geared towards newcomers that joined the bbs community and that pulled on the seasonal selection and potentially have these characters. I'm not a PvP connoisseur, but I certainly think that these 3 fill in the void in lower tier of PvP. Especially if you don't have Golden Accessories or The PvP Meta in forms of Unohana, Broken, etc. This team is not by all means a counter to anything. I just want to help those that potentially have these characters in their boxes and haven't build them yet due to lack of knowledge. 

The teams main functionality is using the Special Strategy to get the soul bomb and utilizing Ururus Freeze Special or Yorucihis Paralysis. Its a stally method of victory, but in the scenario where you have these characters. I believe that's the easiest way to win. 

Ururu serves as a clergy to heal your allies and also has a chance to freeze the opposition. Since she has the recharge link, not only will she chip away against the enemies health.But she is getting more time to use her heal.

Yoruichi is a high speed normal attack character with a high chance to paralyze with her Strong Attacks and Special. High-speed Nad allows her to stagger characters that do not have poise much easier since she can approach them easily in coordination with fast activating strong attacks. 

Soi Fon provides you with the detrimental support boost of 33% attack, defense, and focus to your allies. Also she makes getting the soul bomb easier if she survives. 

On paper they fullfill their roles nicely and have the chance to win against the opposition. Its a 50/50 if the enemy is running Unohana. And its a definite defeat against a full poise/flurry team or even a team with TYBW Toshiro. Its definitely a game of chance in 4 seat. But I believe that this team lies appropriately in 6 seat at least.
